statement.p: Use Green's Theorem to calculate the circulation of \vec F = xy\,\vec i around the rectangle 0\le x\le 7, 0\le y\le 3, oriented counterclockwise.

static.solution: R representing the interior of the square, \int_C\vec F\cdot d\vec r = \int_R\left(\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(0)-\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(xy)\right)\,dA = \int_R -x\,dA. Thus the circulation is \int_C\vec F\cdot d\vec r = \int_0^{7}\int_0^{3} -x\,dy\,dx = -73.5.
